key_points: After-hours selloff alongside NVS and IONS on 9/19 hints at a sector-wide catalyst (regulatory or pipeline-related) rather than AMGN-specific news.
Analyst fair value nudged up from $371.93 to $388.03 — a modest positive but already roughly in line with the 9/18 close of $385.65.
Pipeline risk flagged as the key swing factor, with a split analyst view capping upside conviction.
Dividend-growth comparison vs. Merck is backward-looking opinion content, low signal for near-term price.
